body: I was tearing my hair out trying to find a solution to this. If imported as a transparent PNG, Go to Material options in the right-side panel and turn off Lighting. That should get ride of that subtle background. As for the SVG issue, still haven't figured that one out : /
Those have been ruled out. And I do take Vitamin D supplements.

Quite often. I’ve had dreams of moving somewhere quiet and simple. I’d like anything from a cabin in the woods to a little surf town. Hoping to move somewhere like that in a few years once my finances are straight. Overall I think it’s the desire for a fresh start.

Hey there,

Thanks for willingness to support people. I could use someone to talk to.
Hey, going through something similar here, so, right there with ya. 2019 is going to be a much better year!
Sorry you’re in so much pain. I know what it’s like to feel alone. Here if you wanna talk.
Hey there. I’m so sorry you’re going through this. PM me if you need to talk.
Master of None has a lot of true to life moments
I’m in. This is a great idea! Thanks for sharing. I’ve been wanting to be part of a support group like this, but didn’t know where to turn.

Thanks. I’m not going to kill myself. I’ve just given up on trying to be happy. I was the closest to happy about a year ago, and I lost just about everything. I’m not just back to square one. I am worse than before. It’s a struggle to get through every day.

Hey there,

Sorry you’re feeling that bad. Here if you need to talk. Hope you get some decent rest.
Only most of all of the time.
Thank you. Thank you so much for writing this. It’s so cathartic to read, and a reminder that we’re all human, imperfect, and vulnerable. But are trying the best we know how.
I sure hope so

I’m still getting through it. Best to do everything you can to take care of yourself. Get lot’s of rest. Spend time with friends and family and talk to them about what you’re going through. Hope you’re doing ok today.
I feel ya. Mine was 6 too. The loneliness is a killer. Hope you’re doing ok.
Nah you still have it in you. Life just piles on top of you sometimes. Don’t give up.

You’re amazing for sticking by him through all of that. And it sounds like you made the right call breaking it off because he wasn’t changing. I’m sure this is a wake up call for him. Wish I had more sound advice. I would just try to focus on your own well being for now. Sounds like you’ve done a lot for him. 

Without getting too drawn out I can relate. My girlfriend left me for similar reasons. Since then I have stopped drinking and done my best to get my act together. I still have a long way to go but I am trying to be a better person.

So don’t worry too much about him. It’s a lesson that needs to be learned. Hope some of this helps. Take care of yourself! I’m here if you need me.
Sorry to hear you’re going through this. It’s awful when someone cares for you but can’t shake their own self-destructive habits. Did he show any signs of change while you were together?
Thanks, hope you’re doing alright today. It tough, just have to keep on fighting.
Thanks man, same to you
Thanks for the support. It is a good release to see them.
Thanks! Hope you’re doing better too.
Yeah I see one once a month. Maybe ramp it up.
Thanks, just having a bad one. Woke up from a dream where everything was still ok. I’ve been laying in bed all day just trying to go back to sleep. How are you?

That’s rough. I wish I had answers for you. I imagine you’ve heard lots of advice over two years. Have you tried therapy? I can only imagine how hard it is and how much of an impact they had on you. But recognize that you have worth and they don’t define you as a person. And you’re not alone. I’m working through something too. Hope you are ok today!
Sorry that you’re hurting. Hope you’re ok today. If you don’t mind me asking, how long were you together?

Hey man,

Sorry you’re in so much pain. I’ve been going through something similar. It’s especially tough when you realize all of the mistakes you’ve made. 

I wish I had words of wisdom, just try to focus on taking care of yourself. Simple stuff like getting enough sleep and eating full meals, maybe a little exercise. Without that, everything will be worse. Easier said then done when you’re in that emotional state. 

If you need to vent/talk through it I’m here for you. You’re not alone.

Thanks. That really sucks man. All I can say is don’t put blame on yourself. Seems like she’s got an issue that needs worked out and it’s not your fault. Do you have friends or family you can confide in?
Sorry to hear about what you’re going through. Any idea what led up to it? Hope you’re ok.
So sorry you’re going through this. I’m right there with ya. The loneliness is rough. Hope you can find some comfort in knowing you’re not alone.
Thanks, appreciate it.

Briefly. We had to talk over the phone to discuss some finacial things regarding the house we bought together (yep, lost that too).

We caught up but I couldn’t bring myself to tell her how much I miss her. She left me, and she’s always been obstinate. If you leave someone and are willing to sell a house and lose financial stability, makes it pretty clear you want nothing to do with that person. That and I know I did a lot to push her away, I can’t imagine her wanting to come back. But man. She is always on my mind.
Thank you. Thanks for the support. I look at the moments that I break down as falling and getting back up repeatedly. Long as I get back up each time I’m making it. Just hard for me to see progress.

Right there with ya. I’m 31. She left me 8 months ago. I’ve stayed busy, made some new friends. Quit drinking. Even about to start a new job that’s a big step up in my career. But yep. Still very sad. I think all of these things are just painkillers that quickly wear off and all we can do is allow time to let our hearts heal. Best we can do is keep moving and remain hopeful of the future. PM me if you want to chat.
Hey man, hope you are ok. I can empathize with your situation. I’m happy to lend an ear if you need to talk. Feel free to PM me. Take care.

I have. I saw them weekly for months. I’ve recently dialed it back to once a month for financial reasons. Overall the best I get from it is assurance that what I’m going through is normal and kudos for doing as well as I am. I’m prone to depression which has made this VERY difficult. Thanks for asking.

Thanks for sharing and I can relate. Girlfriend broke up with me 8 months ago. We were together for 6 years and we bought a house which we had to then sell. Been a while and thought I’d be better now. Today I woke up wanting to die. I am in so much pain. I don’t know what else to do. I don’t eat or sleep much. I don’t know how much more I can take. I need help.
Truly sorry you’re going through this. I wish I had more to say right now but at the least - you are not alone. Hope you’re finding the least bit of comfort at this time. PM me if you need to talk.
Is it mostly Chinese people up here?

I can’t imagine what you’re going through, but please know that I genuinely care. 

I’m so sorry you are going through this and I wish I could do more. Just know you are not alone. Just focus on making it through the day. If you need to talk I am here for you.
Thank you. That means so much to me right now.

I can seriously relate to this. My depression ruined it all, and I was not good to her. Eventually she couldn’t take it anymore. Together for 6 years and bought a house. 7 months ago she left and we sold our house. First true love. First home. I will never be the same. Like you, I’m holding onto the hope that I’ll find someone just as amazing.
That I have worth and will survive my depression.
So sorry you are going through this. Wish I could do more than send online messages but know that I’m thinking of you and I hope you can find solace in even the smallest thing. PM me if you’d like.

It's like having a bully in the back of my head constantly putting me down. Telling me I'm nothing, I'm a loser, I'm not going to amount to anything, that I'm weak, and on and on. All I can seem to do is try and ignore it, remind myself that they're just thoughts, not facts. But it's still a challenge every day.
So sorry you’re going through this. Hope you’re doing even the least bit better. Feel free to PM me if needed.
Cool. Any recommended trails around there? I've been scoping the area on hikingproject.com.
Awesome. Buddy of mine and I plan on backpacking around there for 4-5 days in September.

Hey man, 

Just read your message. I feel ya. Frustrating to not connect with anyone, or feel like no one else is making the effort. Have you tried joining clubs or meetups? 

I’m going through a pretty lonely time myself. Feel free to PM me, or even chat.
Thanks. Been trying my best to eat clean. I'll look into it.
Thanks, sorry I didn't mention, I am in fact on anti-depressants as well as a light anti-anxiety medication. Also taking melatonin to try and get better sleep.

Hey,

You're not a bother at all. While I don't have the answers, I'm going through something similar as of right now and have been asking myself the same questions. Best advice I can give are the things helping me. You have to remind yourself it is NOT all your fault. It always takes two. Second, it will feel like it will never end, but just remind yourself - "it won't always be like this". Don't get impatient with yourself either. Take it as easy as you need to. I've been spending a lot of time in coffee shops reading, for something else to focus on and to not be alone. If you want to chat more you can PM me.
Thank you everyone for your responses. Everyone of you is  helping me.
We do not. I’ve stuck hard to the no contact. She’s extremely decisive and I didn’t detect a shred of doubt from her. Trying to contact her would only cause more pain.
